Mechanism: quadratic-priced audit escalation. An auditor's kth concurrent dispute in one grove costs 0.25*k^2 escrow; cases above 10 units go to a five-member summit panel.

Operation: one key per identity; ten open cases cost 0.25*385=96.25 units; verdicts settle in 12 epochs, refunding cost plus 0.10 per correct case; walnut-grade records (rare, hard to forge) add a 1-unit escrow each.

Attack cost: splitting across N identities pays the same quadratic total, so 100 sybils pushing 100 cases pay 9625 units and recover nothing on an honest verdict.
